items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: The main thing, I think, if you're going to capsule it, is that he did do a lot of good records, you know, and that kind of stuff. And I guess he'll be remembered for that, and that's nice.

ctx.x: We were talking about Joe Rufino, I think.

Oh, yeah. Yeah. Well, I'm trying to call it... The main thing, I think, if you're going to capsule it, is that he did do a lot of good records, you know, and that kind of stuff. And I guess he'll be remembered for that, and that's nice.
